subject: Re: Follow-up: Private VPC & SOC 2 discovery (Acme Analytics)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-01T15:02:00Z
Subject: Follow-up: Private VPC & SOC 2 discovery (Acme Analytics)

Hi Elaine / Acme security team,

Thanks again for taking time today — appreciate the thorough questions. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) SOC 2 status: Per our call, you asked for the most recent artifacts. We can share our SOC 2 Type II summary report and the control matrix. I attached the summary (see attachments) and can provide the full report under an NDA if you need it.

2) VPC/private deployment model: We discussed two deployment options — Redwood Private (managed VPC with customer-controlled networking) and an on-prem air-gapped package. I attached our standard deployment diagram (private-vpc-deployment-diagram-v1.pdf) and a short note on the air-gapped option.

3) Vendor security questionnaire: You mentioned an XLS vendor security questionnaire. If you send the questionnaire, Marcus and Evelyn will coordinate answers. If easier, we can also complete a short SOC2 mapping template to speed review.

4) Data handling: Confirmed — customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) supported, we do not retain customer prompt data in the hosted model unless configured. Detailed retention and access controls are in the attached control summary.

Proposed next steps:
- Elaine: share your vendor security questionnaire and any specific network ACL or egress requirements (by 2028-06-03)
- Marcus / Evelyn: internal follow-up and provide responses + any clarifying Qs (by 2028-06-05)
- Quick technical sync (30 min) to walk the deployment diagram and packaging (suggested window: 2028-06-07 or 2028-06-08)

If that all looks good I’ll schedule the technical sync and loop in Dev/Legal for procurement redlines.

Thanks,

Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: redwood-soc2-type2-summary-2027.pdf, redwood-private-vpc-deployment-diagram-v1.pdf

Hi Marissa — thanks for the summary and the attachments.

We’ve attached our standard vendor security questionnaire (ACME_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx) — it covers everything from org security to network topology and third-party risk. A couple of clarifying notes from our side:
- For air-gapped/on-prem: we need to confirm whether any outbound telemetry is required for license/metrics collection and whether that can be disabled.
- For KMS: we require BYOK (bring-your-own-key) support for production data stores.
- For onboarding timeline: procurement is targeting a July 1 start for an initial PoC environment.

I’ve included procurement on cc for any procurement/contract questions. We’re ok for a 30-min technical sync next week — preference 2028-06-07 morning PST.

Thanks,
Elaine
Director, Security & Privacy | Acme Analytics
elaine@acme-analytics.com

Attachment: ACME_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-06-02T09:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Private VPC & SOC 2 discovery (Acme Analytics)

Hi Elaine — thanks for sending the questionnaire. I started a pass-through and attached a short list of clarifying questions inline in the spreadsheet (will return the completed XLS by EOD Friday). Quick answers to your bullets:

- Outbound telemetry: for the Private managed VPC deployment we can disable non-essential telemetry. We do collect anonymous usage metrics for service health by default, but that can be disabled or routed to a customer-owned endpoint.
- BYOK: supported. We integrate with customer KMS providers and can store key material in a customer-controlled HSM/KMS.
- Onboarding timeline: July 1 PoC is feasible for a minimal environment (1-2 GPU nodes) pending procurement and network onboarding.

Evelyn — can you confirm the SOC 2 artifact availability and whether we should prepare an NDA for the full report? Dev — can you confirm if the air-gapped package requires any non-distributable hardware or third-party licenses that Acme should budget for?

I’ll also drop the deployment diagram with network zone callouts (attached) and we can walk through it in the sync.

Thanks,
Marcus
Security & Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-private-vpc-deployment-diagram-v1.pdf

2) For the air-gapped option: list any third-party binaries or image signing we would need to handle. Our compliance team needs details before procurement signs off.

We’re good to do 2028-06-07 10:00 AM PST for the 30-min sync — please send calendar invite with dial-in and a short agenda.

Thanks,
Acme Security
